entries.statement: Case 1 grants Apple with getitem Apple,.@input after Zeny -= .@pay, and .@input is the player's typed count rather than a fixed amount.
conditions: input(.@input) below 1 closes with no grant, and a value above 500 repeats the input loop.
After a count from 1 through 500, .@pay is .@input * 15, and answering No to the confirm menu closes with no grant.
The grant is refused when Zeny is below .@pay or checkweight(Apple,.@input) is 0.

entries.statement: Case 2 removes 3 Apples and 1 Empty Bottle and grants 1 Apple Juice when the player answers Yes and holds those items, and otherwise closes with no item change.
conditions: The player must answer Yes; answering No closes with no item change.
countitem(Apple) below 3 or countitem(Empty_Bottle) below 1 closes with no item change.

entries.statement: Case 1 grants Apple with getitem Apple,.@input after Zeny -= .@pay, and .@input is the player's typed count rather than a fixed amount.
conditions: The shop closes immediately when checkweight(Knife,1) is 0, before the menu.
input(.@input) below 1 closes with no grant, and a value above 500 repeats the input loop.
After a count from 1 through 500, .@pay is .@input * 15, and answering No to the confirm menu closes with no grant.
The grant is refused when Zeny is below .@pay or checkweight(Apple,.@input) is 0.

entries.statement: Boarding consumes one Free_Flying_Ship_Ticket or 1,200 zeny and warps the player to airport 148,51, and it grants no item.
conditions: The player must choose Board the Airship and then Yes.
When countitem(Free_Flying_Ship_Ticket) is above 0, the script removes 1 ticket and warps.
Otherwise Zeny >= 1200 removes 1,200 zeny and warps; a smaller balance closes with no change.
Cancel or No closes with no item or zeny change.
